title: Fastf1 Metric0 Monthly Rollup
dataSources: FastF1 session data (`fastf1:session`), Ergast race results (`ergast:result`), F1 Fantasy teams (`f1fantasy:team`), race watch parties (`race:watchparty`), and F1 telemetry laps (`f1telemetry:lap`).
app: FastF1 session exports, Ergast race results, F1 Fantasy team snapshots, race watch-party logs, and F1 telemetry lap dumps forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fastf1:metric0
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as events, sum(value) as total_value by _time
| sort _time
description: Summarises monthly event volume and total value for fastf1 metric0 data.
value: Monthly rollups smooth daily noise and show seasonal shifts in personal activity.
implementation: Aggregate fastf1 metric0 events monthly and chart count plus total value.
visualization: Column chart of monthly events with total value overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It tells you how your fastf1 metric0 activity added up each month instead of day by day.
